theorem_title: Three shortcut steps agree with five ordinary steps on the alternating block
natural_language_statement:
Let $T:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be the shortcut Collatz map: $T(n)=n/2$ for even $n$ and $T(n)=(3n+1)/2$ for odd $n$. Write $T^k$ for its $k$-fold iterate, with $T^0(n)=n$. Let $C:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$ be the ordinary Collatz map: $C(n)=n/2$ for even $n$ and $C(n)=3n+1$ for odd $n$. Write $C^k$ for its $k$-fold iterate.

For every $q\in\mathbb N$,

$$
T^3(16q+11)=C^5(16q+11).
$$

This is an explicit bridge between the two iteration conventions on the stated residue family only.
preamble:
